mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, type, parent_id, resource, action, sort, status, description, created_at, updated_at FROM permission ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT id, code, name, type, parent_id, resource, action, sort, status, description, created_at, updated_at FROM permission WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT id, code, name, type, parent_id, resource, action, sort, status, description, created_at, updated_at FROM permission WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sort, id

SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.type, p.parent_id, p.resource, p.action, p.sort, p.status, p.description, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.sort, p.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.type, p.parent_id, p.resource, p.action, p.sort, p.status, p.description, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.sort, p.id
SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (code, name, type, parent_id, resource, action, sort, status, description) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{parentId}, #{resource}, #{action}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE permission SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, parent_id = #{parentId}, resource = #{resource}, action = #{action}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
